name: Monitor Process State
summary: Adversaries may gather information about the physical process state. This information may be used to gain more information about the process itself or used as a trigger for malicious actions. The sources of process state information may vary such as, OPC tags, historian data, specific PLC block information, or network traffic.

analytics.name: Analytic 1860
analytics.guidance: Real-time network monitoring identifies a source issuing read-only Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol requests to multiple field devices at a polling rate exceeding the legitimate Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) baseline, from a source not in the approved control server allowlist. Because the action is read-only, source-identity and rate deviation are the only available distinguishing signals. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline.…

OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling,…

analytics.name: Analytic 2169
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies NetFlow showing a host generating an anomalously high volume of short-duration flows to multiple field device IPs at regular intervals, from a source not in the approved Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) server list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
